name: zebracat
description: Create Zebracat AI videos from an idea, script, URL or a reference video, plan first with the exact price, on the same engine as the zebracat.ai chat. Studio tools (hooks, voice-overs, images, clips), avatars and reusable characters, voice cloning, brand kits, scripts, standalone AI images, viral brainrot, and translation of finished videos into 170+ languages.

interface.shortDescription: AI videos, Studio tools, avatars, voice cloning, brainrot, and translation
interface.longDescription: Zebracat Skills turn an idea, script, URL or reference video into a finished video on the same engine as the zebracat.ai chat — AI video with people who speak on camera, AI images in motion, stock footage, and viral Brainrot. Use zebracat-video as the producer (plan, price, edit, generate, deliver), zebracat-studio for single tools (hooks, voice-overs, images, clips), zebracat-avatar to design reusable presenters and characters, zebracat-voice to browse or clone voices, zebracat-brand to set up a reusable brand kit (logo, colors, fonts, tone), zebracat-script to draft and refine a voice-over script before rendering, zebracat-image to generate standalone AI images (thumbnails, hero shots, reference frames), zebracat-brainrot for subway-surfers / minecraft-parkour / italian-brainrot short-form, and zebracat-translate to dub finished videos into 170+ languages with captions.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second video about my product launch
